_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: For the safety of the citizens, these doors shall remain shut until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.dst: Pour la sécurité des citoyens, ces portes resteront fermées jusqu'à la capture du criminel.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: This is utterly inane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: C'est d'une absurdité totale. Un confinement complet, pour un vulgaire larcin... Ne devons-nous pas nous entraider? Voler est inutile.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: The plant has been disturbed- Looks like it was knocked over.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: La plante a été dérangée- On dirait qu'on l'a renversée.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: It's missing a few leaves- Many of them are scattered around the area.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: Il lui manque quelques feuilles- Beaucoup sont éparpillées alentour.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: There seem to be some footprints leading away... It would probably be best to ask about the plant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: On dirait que des empreintes s'éloignent... Le mieux serait sans doute de se renseigner sur la plante.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: I pray to the Light that you are able to help before the situation degrades further.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: Je prie la Lumière que vous puissiez aider avant que la situation n'empire.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: This book describes a potion of enhanced vision.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: Ce livre décrit une potion de vision améliorée.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: ...why are so many of the pages ripped out?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.dst: ...pourquoi tant de pages ont-elles été arrachées?

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I mustn't be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: Voyez-moi tel que je suis- Je m'appelle Korben, et je ne dois plus perdre de temps!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: Maybe there's another way to the window...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: Il y a peut-être un autre moyen d'atteindre la fenêtre...

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: You should probably investigate the collapsed bridge to see where Korben went.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Vous devriez sans doute examiner le pont effondré pour voir où est allé Korben.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall open the doors for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: Vous pouvez aller et venir au village de {p} librement. Nous vous ouvrirons les portes.

similar.text: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: Hey! Please come talk to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: Hé! Venez me parler, s'il vous plaît.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die"- well it's true, or so I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Connaissez-vous le dicton "Les elfes ne meurent jamais"- c'est vrai, du moins je le croyais.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.dst: Halte, voyageur! L'accès au village de {p} est interdit pour l'instant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: Un dangereux criminel rôde dans cette vallée.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.dst: Ces portes resteront fermées jusqu'à la capture du criminel.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: Demandez dans la vallée de {p} si quelqu'un sait ce qui s'est passé

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: Un étranger parmi nous? Quelle joie. Cela fait longtemps que je souhaite partager notre magie avec de nouvelles personnes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: Cependant, j'ai... ma foi, plutôt faim. Et je dois m'occuper de mon jardin pour le moment.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: Connaissez-vous le dicton “Gratte-moi les oreilles, je gratterai les tiennes”? Il faut s'entraider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: Si vous aviez l'amabilité de m'apporter une miche de pain frais, vous pourrez prendre mon seau enchanté.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: Je vous ai vu peiner à le cuire vous-même. Franchement, c'est bien plus que je n'espérais, alors voici votre récompense.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: Si vous avez besoin d'aide un jour, n'hésitez pas à demander. Si vous vous donnez tant de peine pour moi, je ferai de même pour vous.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: Trouvez une utilité au seau de Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: D'après ce que j'ai entendu, le vol n'est pas la raison. Le bosquet était jalousement caché à cause de la puissance de ses plantes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... La Lumière seule sait quoi d'autre. Impossible d'y accéder sans moyens insolites- Et c'est un motif de grave inquiétude.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: Trouvez un moyen de faire pousser la plante près de la cascade

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: Halte! Cette zone est strictement interdite, surtout aux étrangers. Faites demi-tour!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Ah, l'étranger est de retour. Quelque chose vous tracasse?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: ...mmm. Fâcheux, cela. Je ne peux pas vous aider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: Ce n'est ni une question de secret ni de morale- J'ignore d'où vient cette feuille et de quoi elle est capable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: Je ne suis pas botaniste- Simple jardinier. L'erreur est compréhensible, quoique regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: Mais j'ai été formé par une botaniste bien plus illustre, qui aura peut-être vos réponses.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: Elle s'appelle Fiona- Elle vit de l'autre côté de la vallée. Prenez le pont. Elle reste souvent chez elle à étudier.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: Elle a oublié plus que je n'en saurai jamais sur les plantes. Si elle ne peut vous aider, personne ne le pourra.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: Allez à la maison de la botaniste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: C'est scandaleux! Dire que l'un des nôtres s'abaisserait à voler et à détruire!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: Étranger, ce n'est pas le moment de me poser des questions. Ma maison a été saccagée!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: Mm? Damys vous envoie... Vous avez des feuilles d'Iridesca? Hm... Alors nous pourrons peut-être nous entraider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: Le voleur a fouillé mes étagères et mes meubles, puis, le livre trouvé, en a parcouru les pages avec avidité.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: Ensuite, il a jeté le livre au jardin et forcé une plante carnivore à pousser pour dévorer mes notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.dst: Je suppose qu'une fois l'information trouvée, il est allé au jardin, a jeté le livre à la plante carnivore et est parti en trombe vers le labo.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: J'étudie la fleur d'Iridesca, et bien d'autres plantes, depuis longtemps. Tout mon savoir est dans ce livre!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: Rapportez-le-moi, et je partagerai mon savoir avec vous.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: Tuez la plante carnivore et récupérez le livre

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: ...répugnant. Je ferai sécher les pages plus tard, mais d'abord, notre marché.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, non... où est donc Iridesca...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: Ah, la voilà. Les pages étaient collées. Les feuilles d'Iridesca sont puissantes à bien des égards et d'un usage très polyvalent.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: Leurs usages sont incroyablement variés: apaiser les articulations, guérir la maladie, faire vomir ou tuer net, selon ce avec quoi on les infuse.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: Mm? Le voleur a lui aussi de l'Iridesca...? Voilà... voilà qui est très inquiétant. Hormis les miennes, peu de notes expliquent comment soigner ce poison.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: Il se dirigeait vers la guilde des fabricants de potions. S'il prépare un mauvais coup...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: Examinez la boutique de l'alchimiste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: ..vous! Vous me cherchiez! Je vous ai vu suivre mes traces...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: Pardonnez-moi... Mais ce que je fais est une nécessité!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: Je vous en supplie, cessez de me poursuivre!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: Étranger, je sais que les apparences m'accablent, mais vous devez arrêter!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: Ce que j'ai fait était nécessaire, et s'il y avait eu une autre voie, je l'aurais prise.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.dst: Je dois apporter ma préparation là où l'on en a besoin!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: P O U S S E! (En haut gavellien)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: Quelle allure infernale... Je ne vous laisserai pas m'arrêter un instant de plus!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: Ce sera bientôt fait, mais je dois d'abord atteindre ma destination!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: Enfin... Pardonnez ce retard. J'ai dû employer les grands moyens pour vous apporter ceci.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: Tenez, tenez... Buvez, père. Cela apaisera votre gorge.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: ...voilà. C'est fait. Maintenant... Étranger... Écoutez-moi, je vous prie.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: Je sais exactement ce que j'ai fait. Déchiré les recherches de Fiona, troublé les jardins interdits, inquiété bien des coeurs...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.dst: Mon père est tombé malade. Un voyage aux frontières de {p} l'a empoisonné au Kerasot. Il était près de mourir...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.dst: Le village de {p} est un village de parias- Y aller est, stupidement, interdit. Il aurait été exilé, et avec son mal, cela l'aurait tué.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.dst: Le désespoir pousse à d'étranges actes. Je ne pensais qu'à sa sécurité- Le reste m'importait peu.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.dst: Même maintenant, je suis juste soulagé qu'il soit sauf. Si vous devez me livrer, je comprends- J'ai accompli ce que je voulais.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.dst: Je souhaite rester libre, mais que vous dénonciez mes actes ou non ne m'importe plus.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.dst: Voyageur, je dois vous le rappeler- Les portes resteront closes tant que le criminel ne sera pas trouvé.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.dst: ...ah. Vous l'avez donc trouvé. Il s'appelle Korben... Compris. Nous l'interrogerons sur ses actes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.dst: Dans ce cas... Vous pouvez aller et venir à {p} comme bon vous semble. Nous allons rouvrir les portes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.src: ...you... You are... You would lie to the guards and say I perished in the chase? You will keep my identity secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.dst: ...vous... Vous êtes... Vous mentiriez aux gardes en disant que j'ai péri dans la poursuite? Vous garderez mon secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.src: Outsider... You show generosity akin to my father. He passed his Sol Medallion onto me to continue his legacy...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.dst: Étranger... Votre générosité égale celle de mon père. Il m'a transmis son Sol Medallion pour perpétuer son héritage...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.src: ...after what I have done, I do not deserve it. You take it, instead. It is in sufficiently worthy hands, I believe.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.dst: ...après ce que j'ai fait, je ne le mérite pas. Prenez-le, vous. Je crois qu'il sera entre des mains assez dignes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.src: I shall beg the Light to shine upon you for the rest of your days. A thousand thanks to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.dst: Je prierai la Lumière de briller sur vous jusqu'à la fin de vos jours. Mille mercis.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.speaker: Korben
